text: ['Jensen\'s back. He\'s back. He\'s back. He\'s back. He stepped out for a minute, then the board said, "Stay gone." Stock went down. People talk now the lights are back on. He said he was sorry they checked with the top. Eleven days later, they said, "Come back, don\'t stop." Numbers jumping phones ringing, everybody watching the screen. He walked back in like the whole thing was a dream. Jensen\'s back. Jensen\'s back. Stock goes up on the back. Jensen\'s back. Hear that name? 30% not the same. Jensen\'s back. Say it loud or said yes, crowd got loud. Jensen\'s back. One more time. He\'s the one. He\'s the line. He\'s the line.']
